system.description: Once during each of your turns, choose one: while you are in Crisis with Theriomorphosis active, before or after an action, replace one active therioform with another you have learned; or, when you use Genoclepsis in Crisis with Theriomorphosis active, replace one active therioform with one of the GM's choices instead of activating Theriomorphosis. You may end up carrying a mixture of your own forms and the GM's. This does not nest a transformation inside a transformation — it rearranges the one you are already in, which is why the Mutant's Innate-only rule is untouched. By the worn-Guise rule it functions unmasked only.
